newsitem.title: GREECE: ATHLETICS-THIRD TIME LUCKY FOR GARCIA IN 20 KMS WALK.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-THIRD TIME LUCKY FOR GARCIA IN 20 KMS WALK.

text.p: Mexican Daniel Garcia, disqualified in the last two world championships while in a medal position, made it third time lucky on Saturday when he won the 20 kms walk title in one hour 21 minutes 43 seconds.

Garcia, shown the red card in the closing stages of both the 1993 and 1995 championships, took the lead after Russian Ilya Markov was disqualified with only five kms to go after leading for much of the race.

Despite receiving two of the three permitted warnings he kept his composure to take the gold ahead of Russian Mikhail Shchennikov, the Olympic 50 kms silver medallist, after weathering intense pressure from the Russian in the closing stages.
Shchennikov finished second ahead of Mikhail Khmelnitsky of Belarus.
